userStories.title: Persist commitment from previous headline moment
acceptanceCriteria: On each weekly run, a FollowUp row is written for the current week_iso with commitment_text taken from the previous week's headline moment's suggested_alternative
target_metric is one of verification_rate, delegation_rate, or `<dim>_dim_mean`
baseline_value is the value of the target metric as of digest generation
outcome is set to pending on creation

userStories.title: Outcome computed from data, not LLM
acceptanceCriteria: Next week's run computes measured_value for the prior week's target_metric directly from session data
The outcome is determined by comparing measured_value to baseline_value without any LLM judgment

userStories.title: Movement thresholds and delegation_rate inversion
acceptanceCriteria: improved means measured_value > baseline_value + 0.5; worse means measured_value < baseline_value - 0.5; otherwise unchanged
For target_metric == delegation_rate, the inequality is inverted (lower is improved)

userStories.title: No prior commitment renders gracefully
acceptanceCriteria: If no previous-week FollowUp exists, the follow-up panel renders a 'no prior commitment' message rather than failing
The current week still persists its own commitment for next week
